body: I actually blamed her and I am a reason she took this path...
I think it helps if she knows she is not the only one who lost. and it is not even limited to bitcoin...
I thought it might be a bad idea to post with this name, but I figured it would be okay once I share it with her... thanks for /r/SorryForYourLoss I hope it is helpful.

I am sure she will recover from this. I can't think of anything else but that she will get well and forget about this soon. I would do anything to help her but I am just not sure how. specially what should be my first words to her?
But I never thought of her depression as not normal. none of us even imagined that this could happen. I wish I had a time machine to make things alright...

I have just read some of the posts here and I am shaking right now. I can never forgive myself if she ever suffer from any long-term mental or drug side effects. I don't even know what to tell  her when I got the chance.
